description:
£130 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the rental market this spacious four-bedroom property, ideally situated on Goldspink Lane in the popular area of Sandyford.

The property offers generous accommodation arranged over multiple floors, briefly comprising an entrance hallway with stairs to the first floor, two reception rooms, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom complete with a bath and separate shower cubicle. There is also one double bedroom on the first floor, with stairs leading to the upper floor, where two further double bedrooms can be found.

The property comes fully furnished and further benefits from double glazing and gas central heating, making it a comfortable home in a convenient location.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today.
